name: command-30
description: A scheduling palette that turns the typed text into dynamic “create event” suggestions.

files.content: "use client" import * as React from "react" import { CalendarIcon, CalendarPlusIcon, UsersIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Command, CommandGroup, CommandInput, CommandItem, CommandList, CommandSeparator, } from "@workspace/ui/components/command" const when = [ "today at 3:00 PM", "tomorrow at 10:00 AM", "next Monday at 9:30 AM", ] export default function NaturalLanguageScheduler() { const [text, setText] = React.useState("Design review") const title = text.trim() || "Untitled event" return ( {when.map((slot) => ( {title}{" "} {slot} ))} Pick a custom date... Find a time with attendees ) }
